## The idea

Write here in ordinary Markdown. You can use **bold**, *italics*,
[links](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html), and footnotes.[^note]

[^note]: Put a source or a short aside here.

## An example

Quarto also formats equations:

$$
Y = A K^{\alpha} L^{1-\alpha}
$$

And tables:

| Section | What to include |
|:--|:--|
| Idea | The question and why it matters |
| Evidence | The sources or results |
| Conclusion | What the evidence supports and what remains uncertain |

::: {.callout-note}
